name: Diversified crop rotation with a legume phase

soft_risks.risk: Lack of stored soil water can make a second crop in the rotation unprofitable
soft_risks.mitigation: Keep the rotation to seasons with reliable rainfall and use a short-duration pulse

soft_risks.risk: Several rotation legumes grow poorly in alkaline soils
soft_risks.mitigation: Select alkalinity-tolerant pulses such as chickpea and treat sodicity first

mechanism: Alternating crop families breaks pest cycles and alternates rooting depth and residue quality, which sustains carbon and nitrogen supply.
